text:
sam: heads-up: deploy-bot paused the promotion for tag=release-2026.04.12 — build artifact checksum mismatch on promote step.
deploy-bot: "promotion paused for tag=release-2026.04.12, reason=artifact-checksum-mismatch registry vs builder x1"

harry: CI reported the image digest uploaded to the registry (sha256:aa11) but the deploy pipeline saw sha256:bb22 for the same tag during promote. Build logs show successful push and verification.

ci-build: upload log excerpt: `push finished, digest=sha256:aa11`, registry API acked. No retries.

nina: promote path reads registry manifest and resolves digest, then compares against the promoted artifact index. Could be eventual-consistency delay in our registry mirrors or a concurrent re-tag from another job.

sre-julie: I checked registry primary: manifest for tag release-2026.04.12 currently points to sha256:aa11. CDN mirror in eu-west shows bb22. Looks like mirror lag or overwrite. Any other jobs that could have pushed same tag?

harry: there was a manual backfill push two hours ago by infra-tooling to fix a bad layer in aa11, which re-pushed with new digest bb22 and updated the primary, but the indexer job failed midway. So inconsistent state between indexer and manifest.

sam: change window closes in 40 minutes. Options: (1) pin prod to previously promoted good image (release-2026.04.05), (2) wait for registry sync and re-run promote, (3) force promote by digest (risky if indexer inconsistent). Thoughts?

release-mgr: pinting to 2026.04.05 is safest for meeting the window. If we wait for sync, we risk missing the window. Force-promote-by-digest could accidentally point prod at an incomplete manifest if indexer hasn't processed layers.

ci-build: a clean rebuild+push would generate a new immutable digest; but rebuilding adds ~30m and depends on our queued runners.

sre-julie: mitigation: short-term, pin to 2026.04.05. Create follow-up incident to fix registry indexer and reconcile manifests. I'll open ENG-3600. For future, we should fail promotes when the registry indexer reports pending updates.

nina: agree — also add a pre-promote registry-consistency check (confirm manifests match indexer state) to the pipeline. That would have caught this.

sam: decision: pin to release-2026.04.05 to meet the change window. release-mgr, please run pin and note in release notes.

release-mgr: running deploy-bot: `promote --image=release-2026.04.05 --reason="artifact-registry-inconsistency"`

deploy-bot: Promotion queued.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Production tag now points to release-2026.04.05. :white_check_mark:

release-mgr: added release note: "Production cut pinned to 2026.04.05 due to registry artifact inconsistency; follow-up ENG-3600 created."

sre-julie: ENG-3600 created, assigning to infra-indexing team and attaching registry diffs. Immediate tasks: block any manual re-tagging until indexer reconciles; run indexer repair job.

harry: I'll queue a rebuild of the release-2026.04.12 artifacts after indexer repair and confirm digests before attempting a new promote.

sam: thanks. summary: manual pin applied to meet change window; follow-up ENG-3600 (owner: sre-julie) for registry indexing/inconsistency; rebuild and re-promote planned once registry reconciled. Close thread after ENG-3600 has initial triage. :lock:
